name: Life Tap heals the Reaper for damage the Spectral Warden guardian deals (#495)
contract: Life Tap 706788 promises: 'Reduces the cooldown of Spectral Warden by $/1000;s2 sec and it now heals you
equal to $s1% of the damage it deals.' Effect 0 is a bare SPELL_AURA_DUMMY (BasePoints 199, so 200%) with
no trigger spell, so nothing in Spell.dbc executes the heal on its own; it must come from the summoned
guardian (creature_template 100481) dealing damage. npc_ascension_reaper_spectral_warden hooks that
guardian's DamageDealt and heals the owning Reaper for 200% of it while Life Tap is known.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Reaper is engaged, drawing the guardian into the fight
Let the guardian land melee swings on the enemy
The guardian's damage healed the Reaper through Life Tap
